annotations.title: Look up one federal contract by its number

description:
One federal contract or award by its number: who holds it (rolled up to the parent),
    agency and office, what it buys (NAICS, PSC), how it was bought (set-aside, competition,
    offers, vehicle), start, current and potential end dates, option months left, obligated vs
    current and potential value, the modification history, subawards, task orders under it (a
    vehicle) and its follow-on SAM.gov notice when one names it or shares its words. E.g. "tell me
    about contract 36C10B18D5000", "when does it end and how much is left".

award.description: The contract or award number (PIID, FAIN) or USAspending award key, e.g. "36C10B18D5000" or "CONT_AWD_..."
award.title: Award
